To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a superhydrophilic jet boiling surface was fabricated and its heat transfer characteristics were investigated and the heat transfer characteristics of the superhydrophilics jet boiling surface were summarized with the correlations.
the critical heat flux and the heat transfer coefficient are greatly improved by using a superhydrophilic nano-material coating on a heat transfer surface.

the critical heat flux of jet boiling on superhydrophilic surfaces was enhanced by more than 50%, the jet boiling characteristics of the superhydrophilicsurface were different from those of the common metal surface, and the enhanced heat transfer mechanism was the result of the special nano-structures on the superhydrophobic surface.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the heat transfer characteristics of water jet boiling from superhydrophilicity surface.
the development of a new heat transfer surface for the enhancement of heat transfer in the nucleate and jet boiling regimes.

the heat transfer characteristics and heat transfer mechanism of jet impingement boiling from superhydrophilicity surface, the heat transfer mechanism of the jet boiling from the superhydrophilicity heat transfer surface was discussed in detail.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CHF on a superhydrophilic stagnation surface can be increased by 2-3 times compared to that of the common metal surface.

the CHF of jet boiling on a superhydrophilic flat surface was 1.5 to 3.0 times higher than that of jet boiling on common metal heat transfer surfaces, the CHF of water jet boiling was 1.3 to 1.8 times higher than that for pool boiling, and the CHF of steady boiling was 1 to 2 times higher than that in the unsteady boiling regime.
the heat transfer characteristics of water jet boiling in nucleate boiling regime on a superhydrophilic flat surface are significantly enhanced.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the heat transfer coefficient of the jet boiling on the common heat transfer surface was enhanced by 2 times, and the critical heat flux was enhanced by 4 times.

the heat transfer characteristics of the jet boiling on the hydrophilic surface are better than that of the boiling on the hydrophobic surface and the heat transfer characteristics on the super-hydrophilic surface are much better than that on the hydrophonic surface.
the heat transfer enhancement of the jet boiling on the surface was mainly attributed to the enhanced surface wetting and enhanced nucleation site density.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CHF of jet boiling on a superhydrophilic flat stagnation zone can be increased by 2.5 times compared with that on a common metal surface.
the CHF of jet boiling is enhanced by the superhydrophilicity of the surface, which is caused by a special nano-coating process.
the superhydrophilicity is an effective method to enhance heat transfer characteristics of water jet boiling.
